name: skee-mask-terminal
north_star: Adam's Skee Mask: the dark, sparse, PURE-TONE dub side (Terminal Z model) — NOT the granular-noise dense IDM side
reference: Skee Mask · Terminal Z (B min, 99 BPM, centroid 940 Hz, flatness 0.0011, 2.1 onsets/s — dark, sparse, melodic)
caption: dark melodic dub techno, sparse and patient, deep sub bass that swells and releases, rhodes piano echoing through dub delay, pure dark analog synth tones, broken 2-step drums, warm hardware tape character, hypnotic, nocturnal, spacious
script:
[Intro - deep sub and distant echoes]
[Verse - sparse 2-step groove, dark melody]
[Build - dub delays swell]
[Chorus - sub bass blooms, full groove]
[Breakdown - echoes and tails only]
[Verse - groove returns, darker]
[Outro - dissolves into delay tails]
